title: vibecore-platform values — safety-critical keys only
description: Validates ONLY the keys whose silent loss has already caused (or would cause) a production incident. Everything else stays schema-free on purpose: this file must never make an unrelated upgrade fail. Helm validates the COALESCED values (chart defaults merged with the release's reused values) on every install/upgrade/template/lint.

imageDigest.description: Immutable image digest applied to every service that has no per-service override. Empty means 'fall back to imageTag'. A malformed digest is rejected here, at upgrade time, instead of becoming an ImagePullBackOff mid-rollout.
Per-service immutable image digest; overrides global.imageDigest. Set by the deploy workflow from the digest it built, scanned and verified.

serverDeployRollbackFromDigest.description: D2 (approved 2026-07-17): '1' = server rollback re-deploys the retained image by digest (I-REL-1, fail-closed). '0' = explicit kill switch — the api refuses server rollbacks (409) rather than reviving the URL-copy row that re-deploys nothing. Any other value (including '' or a bare boolean) is rejected at upgrade time.
